documentation.text: @dev Throws if called by any account other than the owner

params._addressesProvider: The Aave Pool Addresses Provider address

executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256.details: Executes the dynamic arbitrage strategy and handles repayment.      Reverts if the strategy fails or if repayment conditions are not met.

params.amount: The amount of the token borrowed.
params.asset: The address of the borrowed token
params.premium: The fee charged by Aave for the flash loan.

returns._0: bool Returns `true` if the operation and repayment approval were successful.

requestFlashLoan(address,uint256,address.details: Triggers the flash loan process; executeOperation will be called by Aave

params._intermediateToken: The token to use as intermediate for the arbitrage
params._slippageBps: Slippage tolerance in basis points (1 BPS = 0.01%)
params._sourceRouter: The router to use for the first swap
params._targetRouter: The router to use for the second swap

requestFlashLoanWithCustomPaths(address,.details: Allows specifying custom paths for more complex arbitrage routes

params._firstPath: Custom path for first swap (must start with _asset and end with _intermediateToken)
params._secondPath: Custom path for second swap (must start with _intermediateToken and end with _asset)
params._slippageBps: Slippage tolerance in basis points (1 BPS = 0.01%)
params._sourceRouter: The router to use for the first swap
params._targetRouter: The router to use for the second swap

params._approved: Whether to approve or disapprove the router
params._router: The router address to approve or disapprove

withdrawEther().details: Reverts if called by non-owner or if the transfer fails

withdrawToken(address).details: Can only be called by the owner

params._tokenAddress: The address of the ERC20 token to withdraw
